login.title: RustFox Portal
login.subtitle: Sign in with your portal token to manage agents, memory and settings.
login.hint: The token is set in config.toml [portal] (token or token_sha256). Sessions survive restarts via a signed cookie.
login.offline: Cannot reach the portal API — is RustFox running?

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: System health, agent status and live stats.

chat.title: Chat
chat.subtitle: Direct line to the same agent that answers Telegram.
chat.streamDied: Connection lost — history reconciles after reconnect.

agents.title: Agents
agents.subtitle: The main agent plus every loaded subagent definition.

memory.title: Memory
memory.subtitle: Long-term memory browser — semantic + full-text search.

tasks.title: Scheduled Tasks
tasks.subtitle: Recurring agent runs — no crontab required.
tasks.triggerTypeLocked: Trigger type cannot be changed after creation.
tasks.cronHint: min hour day month weekday — e.g. 30 7 * * * (optional leading seconds field). Times are in the task timezone.
tasks.triggerInvalid: Invalid trigger value (need 5- or 6-field cron / future ISO time).
tasks.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{name}}”? The schedule is cancelled; run history stays available.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Whitelisted fields only — secrets are masked and never round-trip.
settings.soulHint: SOUL.md / USER.md / AGENTS.md — plain markdown, backed up on save.
settings.promptSourceBuiltin: Live source: built-in default (nothing customised yet)
settings.promptDivergence: Divergence warning: a prompt file pointer is set AND the inline prompt is customised — the file wins, the inline copy is dead weight. Remove one.
settings.promptHint: Edit the prompts file through the soul editor below (name: system). Changes apply on the very next turn — no restart.
settings.promptNotEnabled: The file pointer is unset — edits go to prompts/system.md but the bot still uses the inline prompt until you add system_prompt_file to [openrouter] in config.toml.
settings.sandboxInstallingHint: Installing the safety tool. Your computer may ask for your password; RustFox never sees it.
settings.sandboxWindowsNote: Safe mode for commands is not yet available on Windows.
settings.upgradeHint: Same as Telegram: Auto detects source vs release; Main rebuilds from git main; Release downloads the latest GitHub binary.
settings.upgradeSuccess: Upgrade started successfully. The portal will reconnect after restart.
settings.upgradeRejectUnknown: Only Auto, Main, or Release are allowed.

skills.title: Skills
skills.subtitle: Edit SKILL.md files, manage agents, install from GitHub.
skills.col.name: Name
skills.deleteConfirm: Quarantine “{{name}}” to .trash? History is kept, the loader stops seeing it.
skills.bundledNoDelete: bundled skills cannot be deleted here
skills.conflict409: Changed since you read it (OpenCode or another tab saved). Re-read, then retry.
skills.unknownTools: Some tools are not registered. Save anyway?
skills.name: Skill name

install.title: Install from GitHub
install.subtitle: owner/repo[:subpath][@ref] — scanned before anything touches disk.
install.ledgerEmpty: Nothing installed via this portal yet.
